canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Reale

parent.title: A weekend at Reale, Castel di Sangro

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Reale
siblings.summary: What to do around Reale on a late-May weekend: PNALM hikes, Marsican-bear corridor, Pescocostanzo, San Vincenzo al Volturno, half- and full-day loops.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Reale
siblings.summary: Casadonna itself is the obvious pick (Reale is on-site); Hotel Don Luis and Sport Village are the closest fall-backs if Casadonna's ~10 rooms are gone.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Reale
siblings.summary: Zero open IT conferences within 30 km of Castel di Sangro in 2026; the only on-site tech activity is Eni's closed MEAL food-tech accelerator. Nearest real IT events are ~110 km away in L'Aquila, Italian Capital of Culture 2026.

sources.title: Casadonna — official
sources.claim: Casadonna is a 16th-century former monastery in Parco Nazionale d'Abruzzo with 10 guest rooms, integrated with Ristorante Reale on a 6-hectare estate.

sources.title: Reale — official
sources.claim: Reale's address is Piana Santa Liberata, 67031 Castel di Sangro (AQ).

sources.title: Reale — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Reale holds three Michelin stars.

sources.title: Reale & Casadonna — 2026 season notice
sources.claim: Reale and Casadonna close 16 March–9 June 2026; reopen 10 June.

sources.title: Casadonna Reale — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: Casadonna 4.6/5 over 184 reviews; #1 of 4 guest houses in Castel di Sangro; 1-minute walk to Reale.

sources.title: Casadonna Reale — Kayak
sources.claim: Casadonna at Contrada Santa Liberata, ~0.6 mi (≈1 km) from centre of Castel di Sangro.

sources.title: Il Lavatoio Dimora Storica — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: 13 rooms in a restored 18th-century communal washhouse, 200 m from the cathedral.

sources.title: Hotel Il Tiglio — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: Adults-only, family-run, early-19th-c building with travertine, copper, wrought iron; 10 rooms; guest rating 9.4.

sources.title: B&B Il Postale — official
sources.claim: Building on Piazza Plebiscito that housed the old post office; renovated and opened as B&B in 2006.

sources.title: B&B Il Postale — Booking
sources.claim: Rated 8.6/10; homemade breakfast.

sources.title: Agriturismo Il Vecchio Pollaio — official
sources.claim: Family agriturismo, 9 en-suite rooms, garden, outdoor pool.

sources.title: Il Vecchio Pollaio — Booking
sources.claim: Rated 9.5/10; 2.2 km from town centre.

sources.title: Hotel Le Torri — official
sources.claim: Occupies Palazzo Grilli, historic dimora of the noble Grilli family of Pescocostanzo.

sources.title: Hotel Le Torri — Booking
sources.claim: 4-star, 22 rooms in the historic centre; guest rating 8.1; from ~€185/night.

sources.title: Pescocostanzo — I Borghi più Belli d'Italia
sources.claim: Pescocostanzo is listed among Italy's Most Beautiful Villages.

sources.title: Garnì B&B La Rua — official
sources.claim: Family-run B&B in central Pescocostanzo; hosts Luigi, Giuseppe and Elisa.

sources.title: Garnì B&B La Rua — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: Reviews praise hosts; breakfast features freshly baked pastries and goat-milk ricotta.

sources.title: Castel di Sangro ↔ Pescocostanzo distance
sources.claim: Driving distance 18 km, ~17 minutes.

sources.title: Castel di Sangro ↔ Roccaraso distance
sources.claim: ~10.4 km, ~14 minutes.

sources.title: Castel di Sangro taxi operators
sources.claim: Multiple taxi operators; small-town night supply is thin — book ahead.

sources.title: Casadonna — Interior Design
sources.claim: Interiors mix white stone, raw concrete, design and photographic art, modern antiques, iron and wood.

sources.title: Casadonna — Hiddenist Journeys
sources.claim: Minimalist chic design with vineyard and mountain views; unpretentious despite three-star status.

sources.title: Hotel Le Torri — Hotel-Boutique.it
sources.claim: Upper floors house 22 renovated rooms; Palazzo Grilli sits in Pescocostanzo's centre.
